citation: Bukalo O et al. Astrocytes enable amygdala neural representations supporting memory. Nature 652, 434–? (2026). DOI:10.1038/s41586-025-10068-0

parameter_policy.measured_data: Experimental schedule, behavioral stage means, astrocyte transient means, and perturbation effect-size ratios come from the source-data workbook.
parameter_policy.not_measured: The paper does not report BLA-specific KCNJ10/KCNJ16/AQP4/SLC1A2/GJA1 values or quantum-gate angles. These V7.1 core inputs remain neutral/reference values and MUST NOT be described as Bukalo-measured parameters.
parameter_policy.coarse_graining: G0-G9 are functional coarse-grained astrocyte states/microdomains. They are not claimed to be experimentally identified cell types.
